ALL THAT CERTAIN real property, situate, lying and being in the  
Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden, and State of New Jersey, the  
following described real property with the improvements and appurtenances  
thereunto belonging in fee simple, subject to the provisions of the  
Condominium Act of the State of New Jersey, N.J.S.A. 46:8B-1, et seq., its  
amendments and supplements and to the provisions of the Master Deed  
establishing and creating “The 89 Haddon Avenue Condominium”, dated  
November 29, 1994, and to be subsequently recorded.

BEING UNIT “A” in The 89 Haddon Avenue Condominium, said unit  
being more particularly defined in the Master Deed hereinabove mentioned  
and which unit is hereby conveyed in condominium with: (a) Condominium Act  
of the State of New Jersey aforesaid and including in fee, an undivided 39.4%  
interest in the general and limited common elements of The 89 Haddon  
Haddon Avenue Condominium, as more fully described in the Master Deed  
hereinabove mentioned.

ALSO BEING known and designated a portion of Lot 2, Block 11, on  
the Current Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.
